```{r}
#| label: setup-explorer
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(DT)

# Stadium geographic coordinates
coords <- tibble::tribble(
  ~venue_name, ~lat, ~lng,
  "American Family Field", 43.0280, -87.9712,
  "Angel Stadium", 33.8003, -117.8827,
  "Busch Stadium", 38.6226, -90.1928,
  "Chase Field", 33.4453, -112.0667,
  "Citi Field", 40.7571, -73.8458,
  "Citizens Bank Park", 39.9061, -75.1665,
  "Comerica Park", 42.3411, -83.0485,
  "Coors Field", 39.7559, -104.9942,
  "Daikin Park", 29.7573, -95.3555,
  "Fenway Park", 42.3467, -71.0972,
  "Globe Life Field", 32.7473, -97.0845,
  "Great American Ball Park", 39.0979, -84.5082,
  "Kauffman Stadium", 39.0517, -94.4803,
  "Nationals Park", 38.8730, -77.0074,
  "Oracle Park", 37.7786, -122.3893,
  "Oriole Park at Camden Yards", 39.2838, -76.6217,
  "PNC Park", 40.4469, -80.0057,
  "Petco Park", 32.7076, -117.1570,
  "Progressive Field", 41.4962, -81.6852,
  "Rate Field", 41.8300, -87.6339,
  "Rogers Centre", 43.6414, -79.3894,
  "Sutter Health Park", 38.5804, -121.5138,
  "T-Mobile Park", 47.5914, -122.3323,
  "Target Field", 44.9817, -93.2778,
  "Tropicana Field", 27.7682, -82.6534,
  "Truist Park", 33.8908, -84.4678,
  "UNIQLO Field at Dodger Stadium", 34.0739, -118.2400,
  "Wrigley Field", 41.9484, -87.6553,
  "Yankee Stadium", 40.8296, -73.9262,
  "loanDepot park", 25.7783, -80.2196
)

parks <- fromJSON("data/park_dimensions_factors.json") |> as_tibble()

parks_2026 <- parks |> 
  filter(season == 2026, split == "All") |>
  inner_join(coords, by = "venue_name") |>
  mutate(
    marker_color = case_when(
      index_hr >= 105 ~ "#ef4444",
      index_hr <= 95  ~ "#38bdf8",
      TRUE            ~ "#94a3b8"
    ),
    category = case_when(
      index_hr >= 105 ~ "Hitter Friendly (>105)",
      index_hr <= 95  ~ "Pitcher Friendly (<95)",
      TRUE            ~ "Neutral (95-105)"
    )
  )

# Statcast Home Run data
hr_data <- fromJSON("data/statcast_homeruns.json") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    batter_hand = if_else(stand == "L", "Left-Handed", "Right-Handed")
  )

shared_hr <- SharedData$new(hr_data)
```

::: {.glass-card}
## 📍 Major League Ballpark Map

Click any ballpark pin below to view its physical specifications, altitude, roof design, and 2026 Statcast Home Run Factor. Marker colors signify **<span style="color: #ef4444;">Hitter-Friendly (Red)</span>**, **<span style="color: #38bdf8;">Pitcher-Friendly (Blue)</span>**, and **<span style="color: #94a3b8;">Neutral (Gray)</span>**.

```{r}
#| label: map-leaflet
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

leaflet(parks_2026, height = 500, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 14)) |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(lng = -96.5, lat = 39.5, zoom = 4) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~pmax(8, (index_hr - 65) / 4),
    fillColor = ~marker_color,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 2,
    label = ~paste0(venue_name, " (", team, " • HR Index: ", index_hr, ")"),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='font-family: sans-serif; color: #0f172a; min-width: 220px;'>",
      "<h4 style='margin: 0 0 4px 0; font-weight: bold;'>", venue_name, "</h4>",
      "<div style='color: #475569; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 8px;'>", team, " • ", city, "</div>",
      "<div style='display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;'>",
      "<span style='background: ", marker_color, "; color: white; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.8rem;'>HR Index: ", index_hr, "</span>",
      "<span style='background: #e2e8f0; color: #1e293b; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem;'>Runs: ", index_runs, "</span>",
      "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.4; border-top: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding-top: 6px;'>",
      "<b>Elevation:</b> ", elevation, " ft<br>",
      "<b>Roof:</b> ", roof, "<br>",
      "<b>Avg Fence:</b> ", avg_fence_distance, " ft<br>",
      "<b>LF / CF / RF:</b> ", distance_lf_line, " / ", distance_cf, " / ", distance_rf_line, " ft<br>",
      "<b>Max Wall:</b> ", height_highest, " ft",
      "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
  )
```

::: {.glass-card}
## 🔍 Interactive Statcast Hit Explorer

Use the filters below to isolate specific stadiums, batter handedness, or hit distances. The interactive scatter plot and the underlying data table update in real time as you adjust the controls.

```{r}
#| label: crosstalk-controls
#| echo: false

bscols(
  widths = c(4, 4, 4),
  filter_select("filter_stadium", "Select Ballpark:", shared_hr, ~stadium),
  filter_select("filter_stand", "Batter Handedness:", shared_hr, ~batter_hand),
  filter_slider("filter_dist", "Minimum Hit Distance (ft):", shared_hr, ~dist, step = 5, width = "100%")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-interactive-crosstalk
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

p_interactive <- plot_ly(
  data = shared_hr,
  x = ~ev,
  y = ~dist,
  color = ~batter_hand,
  colors = c("Left-Handed" = "#38bdf8", "Right-Handed" = "#f472b6"),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>", player, "</b> (", stand, "HB)<br>",
    "Stadium: ", stadium, "<br>",
    "Exit Velo: ", ev, " mph<br>",
    "Distance: ", dist, " ft<br>",
    "Launch Angle: ", la, "°<br>",
    "Date: ", date, "<br>",
    "<i>", des, "</i>"
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.7)
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>Batted Ball Exit Velocity vs Hit Distance (Client-Side Filtered)</b>",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 15)
    ),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Exit Velocity (mph)",
      gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)",
      color = "#94a3b8"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Hit Distance (ft)",
      gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)",
      color = "#94a3b8"
    ),
    legend = list(
      font = list(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      orientation = "h",
      y = 1.05
    )
  )

p_interactive
```

```{r}
#| label: table-crosstalk

datatable(
  shared_hr,
  extensions = c("Responsive"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 8,
    dom = "tip",
    searchHighlight = TRUE
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  colnames = c(
    "Player" = "player",
    "Date" = "date",
    "Team" = "team",
    "Stadium" = "stadium",
    "Exit Velo (mph)" = "ev",
    "Launch Angle (°)" = "la",
    "Distance (ft)" = "dist",
    "Hand" = "stand",
    "Pitch Speed" = "pitch_speed",
    "Color" = "color",
    "League" = "league",
    "Play Description" = "des",
    "Batter Hand" = "batter_hand"
  )
)
```
